summary.title: TicketVault Threat Model
summary.description: TicketVault is an online event-ticketing platform that allows customers to browse events, create accounts, purchase tickets, and receive QR-coded e-tickets. Event organizers use a separate portal to create events, set prices, and view sales and payout information. The API/Application Server handles authentication, authorization, orders, ticket issuance, and business logic. A relational database stores customer accounts, order history, tickets, payment tokens, and organizer payout details. TicketVault also communicates with an external payment gateway and an external email/SMS provider.
